messages:
anne: Heads up — seeing a spike in fncall -> tool timeouts for the third-party image-renderer. Orchestrator is moving requests to QUARANTINED instead of immediate reject.

mike: Looking at logs now. Are these all schema-valid fncalls that just hit an external timeout?

sasha: Yep. Model emits fncall, adapter invoked renderer, renderer p95 jumped from 500ms -> 3s. We trip quarantine at 2s so many get moved.

deploy-bot: alert: service=orchestrator env=prod severity=high fncall_quarantine_rate=12.4% (5m)

dana: Console currently shows a count + "Quarantined" badge but no action to retry or explain reason. Customers can't see sampled payloads.

kevin: Product question: should quarantined requests consume quota / be billed? We did token decode + routing work but no downstream output.

anne: That's the debate. Ops wants them billed to avoid abuse. Billing/finance want accurate charge for completed units.

sasha: Implementation detail: pipeline tags these as QUARANTINED and we stop forwarding. We still incur small CPU work. Example inspect snippet: `redwoodctl fncall inspect --id=fn-4e2b` -> "state: QUARANTINED, reason: dependency_timeout, sampled_stack: true"

mike: Can we export sampled payloads for quarantines? We currently sample 0.1% for rejects; quarantines need higher sampling to be useful.

dana: UX proposal: add console actions: "Request retry" and "Why quarantined" tooltip + link to sampled payload (opt-in). Also show quarantine counts in route dashboard.

kevin: Concern: toggles are confusing. Alternative: run canary where quarantines are NOT billed, surface them, evaluate for 2 weeks, then decide.

sasha: Rollout plan: emit metric `fncall.quarantine.v1` with tags {reason, model_variant, region, sampled}. Backfill aggregator and create dashboard. Canary 5% projects for 48h.

anne: Also want an admin console affordance to move quarantined items back to the retry queue after downstream recovery.

mike: Note: requeueing will re-run schema validators; if model or schema changed we should surface a warning before retry.

dana: I'll create Figma mockups: view sample payload, request retry modal, billing toggle per project, and auto-retry policy settings.

kevin: I'll write the billing risk doc recommending `no-bill` during the canary window; we can flip after analysis.

lucy: Also propose an alert: create JIRA if quarantines >2% sustained per route for >30m.

anne: Action items: sasha -> metrics + CLI inspector by EOD Fri; mike -> admin retry API; dana -> mockups by Tue; kevin -> billing doc. Keeping thread for rollback notes. :thumbsup:
